label: Conveyor
install: set -e; mkdir -p ~/.local; curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.12.0/node-v22.12.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C ~/.local --strip-components=1; curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash; npm install -g @openai/codex; mkdir -p ~/.local/bin; curl -fsSL -o ~/.local/bin/jq https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/download/jq-1.8.1/jq-linux-amd64; echo "020468de7539ce70ef1bceaf7cde2e8c4f2ca6c3afb84642aabc5c97d9fc2a0d  $HOME/.local/bin/jq" | sha256sum -c -; chmod +x ~/.local/bin/jq
preflight: claude --version && codex --version && v=$(jq --version) && n=$(printf %s "$v" | grep -oE '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+' | head -n 1) && { [ -n "$n" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n' 1.8 "$n" | sort -V | head -n 1)" = 1.8 ] || { echo "jq in the container is $v: Conveyor needs jq 1.8 or newer" >&2; exit 1; }; } && git --version
